scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @bandera/shared" "npm run dev -w @bandera/server" "npm run dev -w @bandera/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bandera/shared && npm run build -w @bandera/server && npm run build -w @bandera/client
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @bandera/shared && npm run build -w @bandera/server
scripts.build:client: npm run build -w @bandera/shared && npm run build -w @bandera/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bandera/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
